hook: Adarsh Hiremath is a co-founder of Mercor and, since January 2026, its co-chief executive alongside Brendan Foody, after three years as chief technology officer. Mercor began as an AI system that interviews and matches candidates and became a marketplace of experts who train AI models for the major labs. He studied computer science at Harvard in a concurrent bachelor's and master's program.
